title: A股港股早报：芯片与存储领跌，支付走强；长飞逆势、汽车财报承压 + 美股盘前：科技反弹与油价回落支撑期指，NVDA与PCE前保持条件式看多
summary: Moomoo完整扫描145个美股行业，基础设施运营、纸制品与折扣零售领涨，半导体、汽车制造和电脑硬件居末；黄金行业上涨0.76%，贵金属与白银小跌。Sparks完整读取116个概念，支付与社交媒体居前，数据存储和激光雷达领跌。12:17夜盘QQQ、SPY、DIA代理转正，但GLD、SLV转跌；A/H午间长飞上涨8.81%，小鹏和零跑财报后分别下跌9.73%和7.25%。 早段标普500与道指期指约涨0.4%、纳指期指约涨0.8%，NVDA、AMD、MU、SNDK与WDC盘前反弹，布油回落至约88.19美元；美加关税、伊朗制裁、周三PCE与NVDA财报仍限制追涨。今晚关注INTU、ZM、SMTC、BOX与NCNO财报。

关键词云图

芯片与存储承压长飞逆势小鹏财报低预期零跑利好负反馈数字支付激光雷达夜盘修复金银夜盘转弱伊朗制裁阿里相对稳健中兴双市场午间补发
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
伊朗警告将强硬回应美国新制裁
美联社8月24日报道，美国公布扩大制裁后，伊朗警告将作出强硬回应；冲突与制裁同时压低风险偏好，并令油运、黄金和亚洲输入型通胀保持事件溢价。
国际
外交窗口与报复威胁并存，能源路径仍不稳定
伊朗方面一面强调外交仍可能打破僵局，一面警告支持美国经济措施的国家可能遭到报复。事实是冲突尚未消退；判断上，油价上冲利多能源、却会压制成长估值。
科技
完整行业榜显示防御零售领涨，芯片与硬件居末
Moomoo完整读取5页145个行业：基础设施运营+5.13%、纸制品+2.77%、折扣零售+2.61%、食品杂货+2.39%、水务+2.38%居前；卡车运输-3.02%、半导体-3.08%、铝-3.13%、汽车制造-3.41%、电脑硬件-4.01%居末。黄金+0.76%，贵金属-0.15%、白银-0.16%。
科技
Sparks支付主题领涨，数据存储与激光雷达重挫
Sparks完整扫描116个概念：SOL储备+3.47%、数字支付+2.44%、信用卡支付+2.21%、黑色星期五+1.82%、社交媒体+1.67%居前；枪械-3.36%、苹果链-3.37%、电动车-3.46%、数据存储-5.51%、激光雷达-6.42%居末。MA +3.31%、RMBS -4.57%，A/H映射偏向支付平台，压制存储、消费电子和智能驾驶。
科技
美股芯片与存储现金时段下挫，夜盘出现局部修复
现金时段半导体行业-3.08%，NVDA -2.91%、MU -5.83%、SNDK -6.45%；12:17 CST夜盘NVDA +0.604%、MU +0.985%、SNDK +0.259%、UMC +1.102%。这是跌后修复而非趋势反转，A/H午间中际旭创-3.16%、新易盛-2.62%说明映射仍弱。
科技
激光雷达与数据存储夜盘反向，弱势排序出现潜在反转
Sparks激光雷达-6.42%、数据存储-5.51%，但代表股MVIS和RMBS夜盘分别+1.764%与+1.470%，构成潜在反转；若A/H下午智能驾驶或存储未跟随修复，则美股夜盘信号对本地市场失效。
财报
零跑收入与EPS超预期，但午间股价下跌7.25%
Futu财报日历显示零跑二季度收入272.87亿元，高于预期256.83亿元；EPS 0.15，高于预期0.05；EBIT 5.38亿元，高于预期4.84亿元。11:59 CST报39.66港元、跌7.25%，利好兑现后负反馈意味着不宜仅按基本面追涨。
财报
小鹏收入、EPS与EBIT均低于预期，午间下跌9.73%
Futu财报日历显示小鹏二季度收入197.44亿元，低于预期204.96亿元；EPS -0.70，差于预期-0.30；EBIT -11.43亿元，差于预期-8.88亿元。11:59 CST报43.04港元、跌9.73%，对港股电动车和智能驾驶形成直接压力。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
夜盘ETF代理转正，纳指修复最明显
Futu OpenD于12:17 CST显示：QQQ（纳指100代理）+0.351%、SPY（标普500代理）+0.134%、DIA（道指代理）+0.016%。均为ETF夜盘代理而非指数期货；行情字段为实时夜盘值，抓取时有成交。
板块对照
板块对照出现确认、背离与潜在反转
行业代表股：DLTR +0.563%、UMC +1.102%、BTCT +32.758%确认各自现金方向；CENX、GGR有成交但0.000%为背离；BEEP、SUZ、SFM、GWRS、TOPP无夜盘成交。概念代表股：DEFT +1.064%、SNAP +0.180%确认强势，MA -0.036%背离支付领涨；GM +0.011%、RMBS +1.470%、MVIS +1.764%对隔夜弱势构成潜在反转，POWW与QRVO无成交。
A/H映射
A/H午间验证：长飞独强，汽车与资源负反馈
11:59 CST，长飞+8.81%、中兴H/A分别+0.34%/+0.54%，阿里+0.53%；小鹏-9.73%、零跑-7.25%、紫金H/A分别-3.85%/-3.18%、洛钼-4.16%。因此下午优先长飞和通信设备的相对强度，电动车与资源反弹需先收复午间跌幅；GLD夜盘-0.353%、SLV -1.237%进一步削弱贵金属追涨。

盘前结论

事实：完整行业与概念榜显示防御零售、支付和社交媒体居前，芯片、数据存储、激光雷达、电动车和电脑硬件居末；12:17夜盘QQQ、SPY、DIA均转正。但A/H午间科技并未全面跟随，中际旭创和新易盛仍跌，资源与汽车财报股负反馈明显。

判断：下午以长飞和通信设备的相对强度为主，阿里和中兴可作低波动观察；芯片夜盘修复只有在CPO与半导体同业同步收窄跌幅时才升级为确认。

不确定性：本次早报因自动化延误于午间补发，原盘前信号已用11:59行情校验。若长飞跌破140.8港元昨收、QQQ转负或油价与长债同步上行，当前选择性修复逻辑失效。

重点个股推荐

长飞光纤光缆
06869.HK
业绩驱动

推荐理由：午间涨8.81%，显著强于CPO同业，二季度业绩提供独立催化。

触发因素：下午守住140.8港元昨收且成交维持活跃。

风险点：中际旭创和新易盛仍跌，若同业继续走弱或长飞回补涨幅，独立行情可能衰减。

中兴通讯
00763.HK / 000063.SZ
国产算力

推荐理由：H/A午间分别涨0.34%和0.54%，在科技弱势中保持韧性。

触发因素：通信设备同业跌幅收窄，且H/A两地成交同步放大。

风险点：美股半导体现金时段大跌，若QQQ夜盘转负，估值修复受限。

阿里巴巴-W
09988.HK
支付平台

推荐理由：午间涨0.53%，与数字支付、社交媒体概念居前形成平台映射。

触发因素：下午守住112.5港元昨收并强于恒生科技指数。

风险点：MA夜盘-0.036%与支付概念领涨形成背离，主题延续性仍需验证。

紫金矿业
02899.HK / 601899.SH
等待确认

推荐理由：黄金行业现金时段仍涨0.76%，公司具备金铜双重映射。

触发因素：H/A分别收复38.44港元与34.54元昨收，且GLD夜盘止跌。

风险点：午间H/A分别跌3.85%和3.18%，GLD、SLV夜盘转弱，当前不宜追涨。

板块轮动看板

受益方向长飞、通信设备、数字支付与平台互联网；以午间相对强度和夜盘修复共同验证。
观察方向半导体、数据存储、激光雷达；夜盘代表股反弹但A/H映射仍弱。
压力方向小鹏、零跑及广义电动车，紫金、洛钼等资源股；均出现明确午间负反馈。
验证信号长飞守住昨收、QQQ保持正值、CPO同业收窄跌幅、GLD和SLV是否止跌。

逻辑链

美股半导体、数据存储与激光雷达大跌，A/H科技开盘首先承受估值与风险偏好压力。
夜盘QQQ及芯片代表股转正，提供跌后修复信号，但不自动推翻现金时段弱势。
A/H午间长飞独强而中际旭创、新易盛仍跌，说明业绩驱动优于板块普涨。
小鹏财报低预期、零跑利好负反馈，港股电动车链进入业绩兑现压力期。
若长飞守住昨收且科技同业修复，可选择性增配；若QQQ转负或资源继续下挫，则保持防守。

风险雷达

自动化延误与时点错位

本次早报于午间补发，盘前判断已用11:59行情重做验证。

芯片修复不具广度

现金时段半导体与存储跌幅较大，夜盘反弹可能只是技术修复。

汽车财报负反馈

小鹏显著miss，零跑beat仍下跌，行业估值面临再定价。

贵金属信号反转

黄金行业现金时段上涨，但GLD和SLV夜盘转跌。

中东风险升级

新制裁与报复可能推高油价、通胀和亚洲进口成本。

数据来源与时间点

来源：Moomoo美股行业榜（12:05 CST复核；页面显示08/24 20:17 ET；完整5页145行业，黄金/贵金属/白银/铜/半导体重点检查）；Futunn Sparks结构化榜单（12:10 CST单次解析并复用，完整116概念）；Futu OpenD HK/SH/SZ财报日历、NOTICE搜索、财报价格与A/H午间快照（11:59—12:17 CST）；Futu OpenD QQQ/SPY/DIA、行业与概念代表股夜盘字段（12:17 CST，ETF代理非指数期货，零成交明确标注）；AP 8月24日伊朗制裁与冲突报道。抓取时间为Asia/Shanghai；本次因自动化延误于午间补发。

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicates heat/importance, not percentage change.
Major News Summary
Global
Iran warns of a harsh response to new US sanctions
AP reported on Aug. 24 that Iran warned of a harsh response after the US expanded sanctions. The conflict-and-sanctions mix keeps event premia elevated for oil shipping, gold and Asian imported inflation.
Global
Diplomatic openings coexist with retaliation threats
Iran continued to describe diplomacy as a possible way out while warning countries that support US economic measures. The conflict remains unresolved; an oil spike would help energy but pressure growth valuations.
Tech
The full industry ranking favors defensive retail while chips and hardware lag
Moomoo read all 145 industries across five pages. Infrastructure Operations +5.13%, Paper +2.77%, Discount Stores +2.61%, Grocery +2.39% and Water +2.38% led; Trucking -3.02%, Semiconductors -3.08%, Aluminum -3.13%, Auto Manufacturers -3.41% and Computer Hardware -4.01% lagged. Gold rose 0.76%, while Precious Metals fell 0.15% and Silver 0.16%.
Tech
Payment themes lead Sparks as data storage and lidar plunge
The complete 116-concept Sparks scan put SOL Reserve +3.47%, Digital Payment +2.44%, Credit Card Payment +2.21%, Black Friday +1.82% and Social Media +1.67% on top. Firearms -3.36%, Apple Ecosystem -3.37%, EVs -3.46%, Data Storage -5.51% and Lidar -6.42% were last. MA gained 3.31% while RMBS fell 4.57%, favoring payment platforms over storage, consumer electronics and smart-driving links in A/H.
Tech
US chips and storage slid in cash trading before a partial overnight repair
The semiconductor industry fell 3.08%; NVDA lost 2.91%, MU 5.83% and SNDK 6.45%. At 12:17 CST, overnight trading showed NVDA +0.604%, MU +0.985%, SNDK +0.259% and UMC +1.102%. This is a rebound, not a confirmed reversal; at midday, Zhongji Innolight was down 3.16% and Eoptolink 2.62%.
Tech
Lidar and data storage reverse overnight after ranking at the bottom
Sparks put Lidar at -6.42% and Data Storage at -5.51%, while representatives MVIS and RMBS rose 1.764% and 1.470% overnight, a potential reversal. The signal fails for A/H if local smart-driving and storage names do not recover in the afternoon.
Earnings
Leapmotor beats on revenue and EPS but falls 7.25% by midday
Futu showed Q2 revenue of RMB27.287bn versus RMB25.683bn expected, EPS of RMB0.15 versus RMB0.05, and EBIT of RMB538m versus RMB484m. At 11:59 CST it traded at HKD39.66, down 7.25%, so favorable fundamentals received negative price feedback.
Earnings
XPeng misses on revenue, EPS and EBIT and falls 9.73%
Futu showed Q2 revenue of RMB19.744bn versus RMB20.496bn expected, EPS of -RMB0.70 versus -RMB0.30, and EBIT of -RMB1.143bn versus -RMB888m. At 11:59 CST it traded at HKD43.04, down 9.73%, directly pressuring Hong Kong EV and smart-driving shares.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight Indexes
Overnight ETF proxies turn positive, led by the Nasdaq rebound
Futu OpenD at 12:17 CST showed QQQ (Nasdaq-100 proxy) +0.351%, SPY (S&P 500 proxy) +0.134% and DIA (Dow proxy) +0.016%. These are traded overnight ETF proxies, not index futures; each had fresh overnight volume at capture.
Sector Cross-check
The cross-check shows confirmations, divergences and potential reversals
Industry representatives: DLTR +0.563%, UMC +1.102% and BTCT +32.758% confirmed their cash-session direction; CENX and GGR traded flat, a divergence; BEEP, SUZ, SFM, GWRS and TOPP had no overnight trades. Concept representatives: DEFT +1.064% and SNAP +0.180% confirmed strength, while MA -0.036% diverged from payment leadership. GM +0.011%, RMBS +1.470% and MVIS +1.764% were potential reversals of weak concepts; POWW and QRVO had no trades.
A/H Mapping
A/H midday check: YOFC stands out while EVs and resources weaken
At 11:59 CST, YOFC was +8.81%, ZTE H/A +0.34%/+0.54% and Alibaba +0.53%; XPeng was -9.73%, Leapmotor -7.25%, Zijin H/A -3.85%/-3.18% and CMOC -4.16%. The afternoon therefore favors YOFC and communications-equipment relative strength. EVs and resources need to recover midday losses first; GLD -0.353% and SLV -1.237% overnight further weaken the case for chasing precious metals.

Pre-open Conclusion

Fact: the complete industry and concept rankings favor defensive retail, payments and social media, while chips, storage, lidar, EVs and computer hardware lag; QQQ, SPY and DIA all turned positive overnight.Yet A/H did not confirm a broad tech rebound by midday: Zhongji Innolight and Eoptolink remained down, while resources and EV earnings names showed clear negative feedback.

View: favor YOFC and communications-equipment relative strength in the afternoon, with Alibaba and ZTE as lower-volatility watches. Upgrade the chip rebound only if CPO and semiconductor peers narrow losses together.

Uncertainty: this brief was delayed and published at midday, so the original pre-open signals were checked against 11:59 prices. The selective-repair thesis fails if YOFC breaks HKD140.8, QQQ turns negative, or oil and long yields rise together.

Stocks to Watch

YOFC
06869.HK
Earnings-led

Rationale: up 8.81% by midday and far stronger than CPO peers, with Q2 earnings as an independent catalyst.

Trigger: holds the HKD140.8 prior close with active turnover in the afternoon.

Risk: Zhongji Innolight and Eoptolink remain down; continued peer weakness or a gap fill would erode the independent move.

ZTE
00763.HK / 000063.SZ
Domestic Compute

Rationale: H/A shares rose 0.34% and 0.54% by midday, resilient in a weak tech tape.

Trigger: communications-equipment peers narrow losses and turnover expands in both listings.

Risk: the US semiconductor cash-session selloff caps valuation repair if QQQ turns negative.

Alibaba
09988.HK
Payment Platform

Rationale: up 0.53% by midday, mildly mapping to leading payment and social-media themes.

Trigger: holds the HKD112.5 prior close and outperforms the Hang Seng Tech Index.

Risk: MA -0.036% overnight diverges from payment leadership, so theme persistence needs confirmation.

Zijin Mining
02899.HK / 601899.SH
Await Confirmation

Rationale: the Gold industry still rose 0.76% in cash trading and Zijin carries gold and copper exposure.

Trigger: H/A recover HKD38.44 and RMB34.54 prior closes and GLD stabilizes overnight.

Risk: H/A were down 3.85% and 3.18% by midday while GLD and SLV reversed lower; do not chase now.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesYOFC, communications equipment, digital payments and platforms, confirmed by midday relative strength and overnight repair.
WatchSemiconductors, data storage and lidar; representatives rebound overnight but A/H mapping remains weak.
PressureXPeng, Leapmotor and broader EVs, plus Zijin and CMOC resources; all showed clear midday negative feedback.
ValidationYOFC holds the prior close, QQQ stays positive, CPO peers narrow losses, and GLD/SLV stabilize.

Logic Chain

US semiconductors, data storage and lidar sold off, pressuring A/H tech valuations and risk appetite at the open.
QQQ and chip representatives turned positive overnight, offering a rebound signal without erasing cash-session weakness.
YOFC stood out by midday while Zhongji Innolight and Eoptolink stayed down, favoring earnings-driven selection over a broad rally.
XPeng missed and Leapmotor fell despite a beat, putting Hong Kong EVs into an earnings-repricing phase.
Add selectively if YOFC holds its prior close and tech peers repair; remain defensive if QQQ turns negative or resources keep falling.

Risk Radar

Automation delay and timing mismatch

This pre-open brief was released at midday; all forecasts were rechecked against 11:59 prices.

Chip repair lacks breadth

Semiconductors and storage fell sharply in cash trading; overnight gains may be only technical.

Negative EV earnings feedback

XPeng missed while Leapmotor fell despite a beat, forcing sector repricing.

Precious-metals reversal

Gold rose in cash trading, but GLD and SLV reversed lower overnight.

Middle East escalation

New sanctions and retaliation could lift oil, inflation and Asian import costs.

entries.title: 科技反弹与油价回落支撑期指，NVDA与PCE前保持条件式看多
entries.title_en: Tech rebound and lower oil lift futures; stay conditional before NVDA and PCE
entries.summary: 早段标普500与道指期指约涨0.4%、纳指期指约涨0.8%，NVDA、AMD、MU、SNDK与WDC盘前反弹，布油回落至约88.19美元；美加关税、伊朗制裁、周三PCE与NVDA财报仍限制追涨。今晚关注INTU、ZM、SMTC、BOX与NCNO财报。

重大新闻汇总
期指
科技反弹推动美股期指走高
早段标普500与道指期指均约涨0.4%，纳指100期指约涨0.8%。这是周一纳指下跌200点、芯片与存储再度承压后的修复，开盘仍需验证成交广度。
能源
油价大跌，市场淡化伊朗制裁的即时供给冲击
布油约跌2.6%至88.19美元，WTI约跌3%至82.36美元。美国称将加强对伊朗的经济施压，但细节与执行时间不足，短线油价选择回落。
国际
美加贸易摩擦升级，加拿大准备定向反制
美国对部分加拿大商品加征50%关税并威胁汽车、零部件和钢铁；加拿大称将公布报复措施。汽车、工业和跨境供应链仍面临成本与需求不确定性。
利率
长债焦虑缓和但尚未解除
市场关注财政部可能动用现金账户增加国债购买的报道，债券代理走强；不过长期债务和通胀担忧仍令长端收益率成为科技估值约束。
宏观
周三PCE与周五Jackson Hole抬高事件风险
PCE将检验通胀黏性，市场仍计入年内一次25基点加息可能；周五美联储主席Warsh讲话将决定收益率与成长股能否延续修复。
财报
今晚软件与连接芯片财报密集
INTU、ZM、BOX、NCNO、SMTC均列在8月25日盘后日历。市场更重视全年指引、企业客户留存、AI变现和连接业务需求，而非仅看当季EPS。
半导体
AMD、MU、SNDK与WDC同步反弹
盘前AMD约涨2.8%、MU约涨2.3%、SNDK约涨3%、WDC约涨2.7%；亚洲芯片股走强提供映射，但周一重挫后的反弹尚不能证明趋势反转。
AI
NVDA周三财报前反弹约1.3%
Reuters盘前显示NVDA约涨1.3%，市场等待周三盘后财报。高预期下，数据中心增速、下一代平台供给和毛利率指引比单一EPS beat更重要。
大型科技
META约涨1%，大型科技形成正广度
META盘前约涨1%，与NVDA及芯片链共同上行，说明反弹并非单一小盘异动；但在PCE与NVDA财报前，开盘成交与相对QQQ强弱仍是确认条件。
盘前
财报前价格反馈分化，BOX与NCNO相对稳健
可得前收口径显示BOX与NCNO周一分别上涨约1.6%与1.6%，INTU涨约0.8%；ZM与SMTC分别下跌约2.4%与2.6%。盘前实时量能公开快照不完整，因此开盘前后成交确认是硬条件。

盘前结论

早段期指全面走高，AMD、MU、SNDK与WDC同步反弹，油价大跌又给成长估值提供短线缓冲。基准情景是科技带动高开，但更像重大事件前的跌后修复，而非新的单边趋势。

美加关税、伊朗制裁、周三PCE和NVDA财报仍构成连续风险墙。若半导体开盘保持强于QQQ且成交扩张，反弹可向AI基础设施与大型科技扩散。

若纳指期指回吐早段涨幅、NVDA跌破盘前支撑或长端收益率反弹，应降低追涨强度。

重点个股推荐

Advanced Micro Devices
AMD
盘前领涨

推荐理由：盘前约涨2.8%，强于NVDA和大盘期指，且受益于芯片链整体修复；公开快照未给可靠盘前量能。

触发因素：开盘后继续强于SOXX与NVDA，并出现成交扩张。

风险点：NVDA财报前仓位回补可能很快结束；若跌破盘前区间，停止追多。

Micron Technology
MU
存储修复

推荐理由：盘前约涨2.3%，与SNDK、WDC共振，修复周一存储链明显回撤。

触发因素：开盘守住盘前涨幅且存储同业同步放量。

风险点：前一日跌幅较大，当前仅属修复；NVDA指引或存储价格预期转弱会再度施压。

SanDisk
SNDK
相对强势

推荐理由：盘前约涨3%，领先多数大型半导体，并与WDC、MU形成板块广度。

触发因素：开盘维持强于WDC与QQQ，且成交不显著衰减。

风险点：周一曾大跌，波动与筹码压力高；若高开低走应降级为观察。

Meta Platforms
META
大型科技承接

推荐理由：盘前约涨1%，在大型科技中保持正反馈，且没有今晚财报的单点跳空风险。

触发因素：开盘后继续强于QQQ并守住盘前区间。

风险点：指数反弹失败、利率回升或AI资本开支担忧会压制估值。

板块轮动看板

强势观察半导体跌后修复：AMD、MU、SNDK、WDC及大型科技META；只跟随开盘后的成交与相对强度。
事件驱动周三NVDA财报与PCE、周五Jackson Hole；今晚INTU、ZM、BOX、NCNO、SMTC财报。
压力方向加拿大敞口较高的汽车与工业链，以及任何高开后成交衰减的高估值科技。
验证信号纳指期指能否守住早段涨幅、芯片是否强于QQQ、油价是否维持跌势、长债收益率是否继续回落。

逻辑链

周一科技与存储重挫后，亚洲芯片反弹与盘前回补推动美股期指走高。
油价大跌并带动通胀担忧暂时降温，长端利率压力边际缓和，成长估值获得修复窗口。
但美加关税、伊朗制裁、PCE与NVDA财报连续到来，资金不会轻易把修复定价为趋势反转。
只有半导体开盘量价继续强于QQQ，反弹才可能扩散；否则应把高开视为减仓与分化窗口。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下是基于已知一致预期、历史 surprise、近期指引、卖方修正和行业景气的主观判断，不是确定事实。已核对Kiplinger/Briefing.com、TheStreet、Bullstory及公司日历；今晚还包括BOX与NCNO，但三档重点样本为INTU、ZM、SMTC。

高概率 · Intuit (INTU) · 68%一致预期EPS 3.58美元、营收42.7亿美元；过去四季三次EPS超预期，AI与中端市场产品提供增量，但全年EPS指引与AI对税务软件的竞争讨论决定价格反应。
中概率 · Zoom Communications (ZM) · 55%一致预期EPS 1.48美元、营收12.7亿美元；上一季超预期且企业AI产品带来支撑，但收入增速温和、线上业务与留存仍限制大幅beat空间。
低概率 · Semtech (SMTC) · 45%一致预期EPS 0.61美元、营收约3.29亿美元；历史上曾小幅超预期，连接业务有景气支撑，但周一价格反馈偏弱、盈利质量和指引门槛更高。

风险雷达

关税冲击扩散

美加反制若覆盖汽车、钢铁或供应链中间品，可能迅速压低工业与消费利润预期。

NVDA事件集中度

周三财报前的半导体反弹带有仓位回补属性；指引不及高预期会放大回撤。

通胀与长债反弹

油价回落只是单日缓冲；PCE偏热或财政担忧升温可重新推高长端收益率。

盘前量能不完整

公开延迟快照未提供所有候选的可靠盘前成交量；必须等待开盘量价确认，不能把涨幅本身当趋势。

数据来源与时间点

来源：Reuters/AP（期指、NVDA与芯片盘前、伊朗制裁、美加关税、油价、PCE与消费者信心）；TipRanks与Yahoo盘前快照（AMD、MU、SNDK、WDC、META、ZM）；Kiplinger/Briefing.com、TheStreet、Bullstory、Newsquawk及公司投资者关系页（财报时间、预期与历史线索）。抓取时间：2026-08-25 20:42 CST。盘前成交量公开快照不完整，个股触发条件均要求开盘后量价确认。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not percentage change.
Major News Roundup
Futures
Technology rebound lifts US index futures
Early S&P 500 and Dow futures gained about 0.4% while Nasdaq 100 futures rose about 0.8%. The move follows Monday's 200-point Nasdaq decline and renewed chip and storage pressure; opening breadth still needs confirmation.
Energy
Oil tumbles as markets discount immediate Iran supply damage
Brent fell about 2.6% to $88.19 and WTI about 3% to $82.36. Washington promised greater economic pressure on Iran, but limited detail and timing led oil lower in the near term.
Global
US-Canada trade conflict escalates as retaliation nears
The US imposed 50% tariffs on some Canadian goods and threatened autos, parts and steel; Canada said it would announce retaliation. Autos, industrials and cross-border supply chains face higher cost and demand uncertainty.
Rates
Long-bond anxiety eases but is not resolved
Markets considered a report that Treasury could use its cash account to increase bond purchases, while bond proxies firmed. Long-term debt and inflation concerns still make yields a binding constraint on technology valuations.
Macro
Wednesday PCE and Friday Jackson Hole raise event risk
PCE will test inflation persistence while markets still price a possible 25-basis-point rate increase this year. Fed Chair Warsh's Friday speech could determine whether the yield and growth-stock repair extends.
Earnings
Software and connectivity-chip reports crowd tonight's calendar
INTU, ZM, BOX, NCNO and SMTC appear on the August 25 after-close calendar. Full-year guidance, enterprise retention, AI monetization and connectivity demand matter more than the quarterly EPS alone.
Semiconductors
AMD, MU, SNDK and WDC rebound together
AMD gained about 2.8%, MU 2.3%, SNDK 3% and WDC 2.7% premarket. Strong Asian chip trading helped, but a rebound after Monday's sharp losses is not yet trend confirmation.
AI
NVDA rebounds about 1.3% before Wednesday earnings
Reuters showed NVDA up about 1.3% premarket ahead of Wednesday's after-close report. With expectations high, data-center growth, next-platform supply and gross-margin guidance matter more than an isolated EPS beat.
Megacaps
META gains about 1% as megacaps show positive breadth
META rose about 1% premarket alongside NVDA and the chip group, showing a broader rebound rather than an isolated small-cap move; opening volume and strength versus QQQ remain confirmation gates before PCE and NVDA earnings.
Premarket
Pre-report price feedback is split, with BOX and NCNO firmer
Available prior-close data showed BOX and NCNO up about 1.6% Monday and INTU up 0.8%, while ZM and SMTC fell about 2.4% and 2.6%. Reliable live premarket volume was incomplete, making opening volume confirmation mandatory.

Pre-Market Conclusion

Index futures rose broadly, AMD, MU, SNDK and WDC rebounded together, and the oil drop offered short-term valuation relief for growth.The base case is a technology-led higher open, but this looks more like pre-event repair than a new one-way trend.

US-Canada tariffs, Iran sanctions, Wednesday PCE and NVDA earnings create a continuous risk wall.If semiconductors stay ahead of QQQ on expanding volume, the rebound can broaden into AI infrastructure and megacaps.

If Nasdaq futures surrender the early gain, NVDA breaks premarket support or long yields rebound, reduce chase risk.

Priority Stock Ideas

Advanced Micro Devices
AMD
Premarket Leader

Rationale: Up about 2.8% premarket, ahead of NVDA and index futures, with support from the broad chip rebound; reliable live premarket volume was unavailable.

Trigger: Keep outperforming SOXX and NVDA after the open with expanding volume.

Risk: Position covering before NVDA earnings can fade quickly; stop chasing if the premarket range breaks.

Micron Technology
MU
Storage Repair

Rationale: Up about 2.3% premarket alongside SNDK and WDC, repairing Monday's storage selloff.

Trigger: Hold the premarket gain while storage peers confirm on rising volume.

Risk: The prior-day loss was large and this is only repair; weaker NVDA guidance or memory pricing can renew pressure.

SanDisk
SNDK
Relative Strength

Rationale: Up about 3% premarket, ahead of most large semiconductors, with breadth from WDC and MU.

Trigger: Stay ahead of WDC and QQQ after the open without a sharp volume fade.

Risk: Monday's large loss leaves high volatility and overhead supply; downgrade to watch if the gap fades.

Meta Platforms
META
Megacap Support

Rationale: Up about 1% premarket with positive megacap feedback and no single-report gap risk tonight.

Trigger: Keep outperforming QQQ and hold the premarket range after the open.

Risk: A failed index rebound, higher yields or AI-capex concerns would pressure valuation.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength WatchSemiconductor repair in AMD, MU, SNDK and WDC plus megacap META; follow only opening volume and relative strength.
Event-DrivenWednesday NVDA earnings and PCE, Friday Jackson Hole, and tonight's INTU, ZM, BOX, NCNO and SMTC reports.
Pressure AreasAutos and industrials with Canadian exposure, plus any expensive technology gap whose volume fades after the open.
Validation SignalsWhether Nasdaq futures hold the early gain, chips beat QQQ, oil stays lower and long yields continue easing.

Logic Chain

After Monday's technology and storage selloff, stronger Asian chips and premarket covering lifted US futures.
A sharp oil decline cooled inflation concern and marginally eased long-rate pressure, opening a repair window for growth valuations.
US-Canada tariffs, Iran sanctions, PCE and NVDA earnings arrive in sequence, keeping investors from treating repair as a trend reversal.
Only continued semiconductor price-volume strength versus QQQ can broaden the rally; otherwise treat the gap as a de-risking and rotation window.

After-Hours Earnings Beat Probability

These are subjective judgments based on consensus, historical surprises, recent guidance, sell-side revisions and industry conditions—not facts. Kiplinger/Briefing.com, TheStreet, Bullstory and company calendars were checked; BOX and NCNO also report, while INTU, ZM and SMTC anchor the three tiers.

High · Intuit (INTU) · 68%Consensus calls for $3.58 EPS and $4.27 billion revenue; EPS beat in three of the last four quarters and AI/mid-market products help, but full-year guidance and AI competition in tax software will drive the reaction.
Medium · Zoom Communications (ZM) · 55%Consensus is $1.48 EPS and $1.27 billion revenue; the prior-quarter beat and enterprise AI products help, while modest growth, online mix and retention limit the size of a likely beat.
Low · Semtech (SMTC) · 45%Consensus is $0.61 EPS and about $329 million revenue; past small beats and connectivity demand help, but Monday's weak price feedback plus earnings-quality and guidance hurdles keep odds below half.

Risk Radar

Tariff Spillover

US-Canada retaliation involving autos, steel or supply-chain inputs could quickly reduce industrial and consumer profit expectations.

NVDA Event Concentration

The pre-earnings chip rebound includes position covering; guidance below elevated expectations would amplify downside.

Inflation and Long-Yield Rebound

Lower oil is a one-day buffer; hot PCE or renewed fiscal concern can push long yields higher again.

Incomplete Premarket Volume

Public delayed snapshots lacked reliable live volume for every candidate; opening price-volume confirmation is mandatory and the gap alone is not a trend.

Sources and Timestamps
